distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) recorded Sichuan (Yibin, Ebian) as Xyleborus pelliculosus. Huang & Lu (2015) retained Sichuan and added Yunnan. Smith et al. (2020) documented Shanxi, Sichuan and Taiwan; Lin & Smith (2022) independently listed Taiwan.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) reported Castanopsis sp., Quercus sp. and Acer sp.; Smith et al. (2020) independently reported these genera but also listed Juglans, Alnus and Betula at genus level. The additional genera remain source-level evidence and are not promoted in the reviewed host synthesis; Lin & Smith (2022) provides no host.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion pelliculosum (Eichhoff, 1878).
